audit.whatIsWrong: content.win reads Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia — six stages to Cassiopeia in a lane she wins 43.21% of over 81 games. CHAMP_FULL.phases reads Riven / Riven / Skill / Riven / Skill / Riven / Cassiopeia, which is what the entry's own prose says: early opens "Respect this lane — the data calls it HARD", whys[0], whys[1], whys[3] and whys[5] all hand Riven the stage. Also, full.diff says EVEN at 5.5/10.
audit.why: This is the losing lane in the slice by seven points and only the content chart and the diff banner disagree. Riven is resourceless with three dashes and a stun before Cassiopeia has two ranks; nothing supports six Cassiopeia stages.
audit.corrected: content.win should follow CHAMP_FULL.phases, and full.diff should read HARD. Not proposed as edits — single-word values cannot move inside the +/-10% length band.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] both describe level 6, so the first-item stage has no reasoning of its own. No cooldown appears anywhere despite the whole plan being "land Miasma on her dash".
audit.why: Broken Wings is 13s, Ki Burst 11s at rank 1, Valor 10s, Miasma 24s. Whether you can hold Miasma for her engage is purely a question of those four numbers, and the reader is given none of them.
audit.corrected: whys[5] rewritten to cover the first-item stage; 13s, 11s and 24s written into spikes[1].text and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The grounding interaction is right and well-stated — this entry is better than most in the slice. Two gaps: Valor is a shield as well as a dash, so it eats the poison tick that Twin Fang needs to hit for bonus damage, and that is never said. And Wind Slash is called an "execute" twice; it scales with the target's missing health, it does not execute at a threshold.
audit.why: Riot: Valor — "Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage"; Twin Fang "deals increased damage to Poisoned targets", so a shielded-off poison tick downgrades the whole chain. Blade of the Exile grants "Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack" — a scaling nuke, not a threshold execute.
audit.corrected: Valor named as a shield in wants.foe[1]; Wind Slash restated as missing-health scaling in spikes[2].text.
Corrected and the 0.75s recast added in its place.

edits.before: Your first real out: rank W (Miasma) and drop it ON her as she dashes in — the ground disables her Broken Wings dashes and E, then you Q-prime and chain Twin Fang while she's stuck and can't reposition.
edits.after: Your first real out: rank W (Miasma) and drop it ON her as she dashes in — grounding kills Broken Wings and Valor, and Broken Wings is 13s, so Q-prime and chain Twin Fang while she is stuck.

edits.before: Riven's biggest kill window — Conqueror stacks plus R's Wind Slash execute can delete you out of one combo; you only flip it if your R (Petrifying Gaze) catches her facing you to stun, not turned away for the slow.
edits.after: Riven's biggest kill window — Conqueror plus Wind Slash, which hits harder the lower you are, deletes you in one combo; flip it only if Petrifying Gaze catches her facing you, since turned away she is merely slowed.

edits.before: Your shred takes over — Liandry's plus Malignance and refunding Twin Fangs out-DPS her once you survive lane; ground her dash with Miasma and she has no MR and no sustain to outlast the poison.
edits.after: Your shred takes over — Liandry's plus Malignance and a 0.75s Twin Fang out-DPS her once you survive lane; ground her dash with Miasma and she has no MR and no sustain to outlast the poison.

edits.before: Bait or eat your Miasma on cooldown, then Broken Wings knockup plus Ki Burst stun all-in while you're grounded-free and defenseless
edits.after: Bait Miasma out, then all-in on its 24s cooldown with Broken Wings knockup into an 11s Ki Burst stun while you have no ground to hide behind

edits.before: Use Broken Wings dashes and the E shield-dash to sidestep your Q skillshots so you never poison a target to chain Twin Fang
edits.after: Sidestep your Q with Broken Wings and Valor, and let the Valor shield eat the poison tick so Twin Fang never gets its bonus

edits.before: Riven's level-6 spike (Conqueror plus R's Wind Slash execute) outpaces your single component while you're still squishy with no MR — her all-in is lethal here.
edits.after: First item is still hers — a Conqueror-stacked Riven with Wind Slash outpaces your single AP component while you have no MR at all, so buy time and farm safely.

notes: content.win gives Cassiopeia six of seven stages in a 43.21% lane and contradicts the entry's own prose; CHAMP_FULL.phases has it right. full.diff also reads EVEN and should read HARD. Neither is fixable inside the length band. The suspectNames flag on "Use Broken Wings" is a false positive — Broken Wings is the correct name for Riven's Q.
